title: नेपालको भूमि व्यवस्था : परिचय, प्रकृति–प्रकार र प्रयोग Nepalko Bhumi Byabastha: Parichaya, Prakriti-prakar ra Prayog
nepali: एउटा स्वतन्त्र राज्य बन्न राजनैतिक सिद्धान्तका हिसाबले चारवटा अत्यावश्यक तत्वहरू अपरिहार्य ठानिन्छ । भूभाग, जनता, सरकार र सम्प्रभुता यी तत्वहरूको समन्वयात्मक संरचनाबाट स्वतन्त्र राष्ट्रहरूको अस्तित्व स्थापित हुन्छ। त्यसैकारण राज्य निर्माणमा भूभाग सबैभन्दा प्रमुख, अपरिहार्य र वाञ्छनीय पूर्वाधार हो । यही वस्तुनिष्ठ तथ्यलाई दृष्टिगत गरी राज्यभित्रको अन्तरनिहित सम्पूर्ण जमिन वा भूमिलाई सुव्यवस्थित, सुनिश्चित र सुसंगठित गर्न सरकारलेप्रत्येक ऐतिहासिक युगमा भूमि परिचालनका आधारभूत योजनाहरू र कार्यनीतिहरू समयानुकूल, परिवर्तन र सुधारात्मक प्रयासहरू गरिरहेको देखिन्छ । राज्यभित्रको सम्पूर्ण भूमि राष्ट्रनिहीत हुन्छ र राष्ट्र राजाको अधिनमा रहन्छ । "All landsare upon the Nation and the Nation is upon the King" यही सारगर्भित सन्देश बमोजिम प्राचीन, मध्यकालीन तथा आधुनिक कालमा समेत सरकारी पक्षबाट भूमिलाई उर्वर, उब्जाउमूलक र जमिनलाई आधुनिकीकरणगराउने सिलसिलामा विभिन्न योजना कार्यनीति, सुधारात्मक प्रयासहरू अगाडि बढाएको देखिन्छ ।
american_english: A separate state can only exist when four essential elements—land, the public, the government and sovereign authority—are harmoniously combined. In the history of state-building, land has been the most important, indispensable and vital infrastructure. To organize the whole territory within the country or the royal domain, the government has been running various land-management plans and corrective measures in every historical era. The whole land lies within the nation and the king resides in it. "All lands are upon the Nation and the Nation is upon the King" is the guiding message, still relevant in ancient, medieval and modern times through government schemes for land improvement and modernization.
british_english: A free state can only be established by political principles involving four essential things: land, the people, the government and supreme authority, working together in a coordinating structure to secure independent nations. Throughout state formation, land has been the foremost, indispensable and vital resource. To lay the whole territory within the borders of the kingdom and let the king dwell therein, the government has introduced various schemes for land management and reform in every age. All lands belong to the Nation and the Nation belongs to the King; this principle remains fundamental in ancient, medieval and contemporary times through government programmes for land reclamation and modernisation.
australian_english: The creation of an independent state rests on four key elements: land, population, government and sovereign control, which must be coordinated to establish self-governing states. Land has always been the most crucial, necessary and vital foundation for state building. The government has been setting up systematic land-use planning and corrective actions in every historical period to organise the whole territory within the country and the crown's domain. The entire land is national soil and the monarch's residence; the motto "All lands are upon the Nation and the Nation is upon the King" guides us today, alongside government schemes for land development and modernisation.
informal_english: It's about making a free country by politics—four basics: land, people, govt and the king. Land's the top priority, you can't build a state without it. The government keeps fixing land rules every age. "All lands are ours, the nation is ours"—that's the idea back then too.
